## Checklist

- [ ] `make ci` passes locally (lint + validate + hook tests)
- [ ] Commands use the `/spx:` namespace; no leftover `/phx:` or `/speckit` references
- [ ] Straight quotes only (no angle quotes) in user-facing text
- [ ] If a file was ported from an upstream (spec-kit or claude-elixir-phoenix),
      the change stays faithful to upstream, or the divergence is explained below
- [ ] If `memory/constitution.md` changed, the 4 derived copies were regenerated
      and the version was bumped (see `docs/RELEASE-PROCESS.md`)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / `docs/`) if behavior or the command set changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]`
